title: Climate Change Act 22 of 2024
citation: Climate Change Act 22 of 2024 (GG 50966, 23 July 2024); commenced in part by Proclamation Notice 251 of 2025 (GG 52319, 17 March 2025)
evidence: Act s.38: "This Act is called the Climate Change Act, 2024, and comes into operation on a date fixed by the President by proclamation in the Gazette." gov.za media statement (https://www.gov.za/news/media-statements/minister-dion-george-announces-proclamation-and-implementation-climate-change, opened 2026-11-02): "The proclamation notice was published in the Government Gazette on 17 March 2025, which is therefore the commencement date of the Act."
notes: Carbon budgets, sectoral emissions targets and mitigation plans. Commencement is partial: the gov.za statement lists deferred provisions 12(6), 13(1), 13(2), 13(3)(b), 14(3)(a), 15(5), 15(6), 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 25(4)(c), 26(2) to (6), 27, 28 and 30(2)(a) and (b). A secondary reading of Proclamation 251 of 2025 omits section 22 from that list; the proclamation PDF was not opened, so the list is unverified. Stored text is the English pages of the bilingual (English/Tshivenda) gazette PDF.

title: Carbon Tax Act 15 of 2019
evidence: Act s.21: "This Act is called the Carbon Tax Act, 2019, and comes into operation on 1 June 2019." Read in https://www.gov.za/sites/default/files/gcis_document/201905/4248323-5act15of2019carbontaxact.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Stored text is the Act as published; later amendments (the Act has been amended by Taxation Laws Amendment Acts and Rates Acts) are not applied. The gov.za documents page was not opened (timeouts); the URL is from a search result.

title: Pension Funds Act 24 of 1956, Regulation 28 (investment of fund assets, including environmental, social and governance factors), as substituted by GN R183 of 2011
citation: GN R183, GG 34070, 4 March 2011; Pension Funds Act 24 of 1956 reg. 28
evidence: Reg. 28 as substituted, para 3: "This regulation comes into effect on 1 July 2011, provided that transitional ..." (GN R183, GG 34070 of 4 March 2011, read 2026-11-02). Reg. 28(2)(c)(ix): a fund must "before making an investment in and while invested in an asset consider any factor which may materially affect the sustainable long term performance of the asset including, but not limited to, those of an environmental, social and governance character."
notes: Stored text is GN R183 of 2011. Later amendments (for example GN 2230, GG 46649 of 1 July 2022, seen only in search results from National Treasury, not on gov.za) are not applied, so this is not the current consolidated Regulation 28. The Pension Funds Act itself is not a separate entry.

title: Prudential Authority Guidance Note G3/2025: Guidance on Climate-related Disclosures for Banks
citation: PA Guidance Note G3/2025 (Banks Act 94 of 1990 s.6(5)); replaces Guidance Note 3 of 2024
evidence: Signed "Fundi Tshazibana, Chief Executive Officer, Date: 07/10/25"; no commencement clause, so the issue date is used. PDF opened 2026-11-02 (200, 435853 bytes, application/pdf).
notes: Guidance, not binding rule: the PA says disclosure timelines will be set later. Replaces Guidance Note 3 of 2024 (10 May 2024) and G2/2025 (24 June 2025) is named as the previous note. The brief expected a 2024 note; the 2024 notes are superseded. resbank.co.za HTML pages refuse the cloud address; the PDF opens.
